entry.description: Keep location information, such as `%location`, `%method`, `%line` and `%stacktrace`, for events logged through `ILog`. Once the JIT optimized a logging method of `LogImpl`, it could inline it or call `Logger.Log` as a tail call, the `LogImpl` frame vanished from the stack, and the location came out empty. Seen on Linux x64 with .NET 10. Wrappers that extend `LogImpl` or pass their own type as the stack boundary need `MethodImplOptions.NoInlining | MethodImplOptions.NoOptimization` on their logging methods (fixed by @FreeAndNil in https://github.com/apache/logging-log4net/pull/357[#357])
